title: Add Stripe configuration status indicator with green checkmark

requirements.text: Update the StripeSetup component (frontend/src/components/StripeSetup.tsx) to display a visual status indicator showing whether Stripe has been configured. Display a green checkmark icon with 'Stripe Configured' text when a valid Stripe secret key is stored in the backend.

quotes: Show stripe has been configured and stored Key with a green tick that shows stripe status in configuration

acceptanceCriteria: A green checkmark icon appears in the StripeSetup component when Stripe is configured
Status indicator text reads 'Stripe Configured' or similar when active
The status indicator fetches current Stripe configuration from the backend using the useStripeConfig query hook
Status updates immediately when Stripe configuration is saved

requirements.text: Add a backend method hasStripeConfiguration() or extend the existing getStripeConfig() method in backend/main.mo to return a boolean flag or status indicating whether a Stripe secret key has been stored, without exposing the actual key value.

quotes: Show stripe has been configured and stored Key

acceptanceCriteria: Backend method returns true/false or status field indicating if Stripe is configured
Method does not expose the actual Stripe secret key value
Method requires admin authentication to check configuration status
Frontend can reliably determine configuration status from backend response

constraints: Do not expose the actual Stripe secret key in any frontend response
Maintain admin-only access control for Stripe configuration endpoints
nonGoals: Validating the Stripe API key with Stripe servers
Displaying partial key values or hints about the stored key
